summary: The convex-slice argument correctly bounds the main and tail portions of the Q_jk area, converts those bounds into the stated lower bounds on the left width slope, and then applies the negative-U cap-area estimate to obtain every positive-part inequality. The A, B, and C endpoint-order cases are exhaustive under the inherited literal strata, the zero-offset cases are handled separately without unsafe division, and all cleared denominators are strictly positive on their stated branches.
